name: QAM Constellation
desc: A vector analyser watching a digital carrier: sixty-four symbol clouds sit on the IQ lattice smeared by Gaussian noise and phase jitter, pulse-shaped trajectories bow between them, and the whole constellation turns slowly on an uncorrected carrier offset while the link fades, compresses and slides toward unlock.

energy.doc: sample rate and dot weight — how densely the clouds fill in

speed.doc: carrier frequency offset — how fast the whole field rotates

noise.doc: channel noise floor — cloud spread and phase smear

trails.doc: how many pulse-shaped transition trajectories are drawn

hue.doc: ink + symbol hue (offset from the style anchor)

style.doc: aesthetic: inked signal-integrity test report on toned stock / dark persistence scope with luminous phosphor clouds / amber bench analyser / radically abstracted — pure white stipple on graphite, no colour, no glow

act.doc: multi-minute programme: a healthy link breathing around 20 dB / a multipath channel fading in and out / a slow slide from 34 dB down into the noise until the clouds merge and the link unlocks

seed.doc: symbol stream, noise and stock seed
